behavior.paging: 20 combined canonical/pending rows; existing cursor, search, permissions and revision contracts
behavior.live: HTTP bootstrap and WebSocket delta use the same compact projection
behavior.canonical_detail: Existing sheet mounts immediately using display-only fields; exact one-order scoped read hydrates the same State before detail effects or authority
behavior.actions: Full scoped order is validated before freeze, early close, edit or editor actions
behavior.pending_detail: Existing pending-order detail and resume use the complete template fetched by ID on demand
behavior.metrics: Only selected-order calculation fallback is computed after detail read; no eager list calculations
behavior.cache: Compact rows persist; legacy full orders windows are discarded on restore while sequence cache is retained

wire_comparison.limitations: Synthetic serialized fixture with the same default compressor; excludes images and transport overhead; not phone timing
